ai_picks.sample_note: OOS sample insufficient for a robust profitability conclusion.

limitations: Historical ROI does not predict future profit.
Thresholds were frozen at AI Picks v0.1 defaults; they were not historically pre-registered as a trading strategy before this protocol.
Odds coverage is independent of model OOS prediction coverage.
This rerun keeps the frozen OOS protocol and only changes the odds input to PostgreSQL live PIT snapshots.
114/387 is odds coverage from the historical expansion, not an AI Picks count.
Multiple bookmakers can share available_at; PIT still selects the last complete 1X2 by (available_at, collected_at, snapshot.id).

manifest.odds_selection_policy: Last complete 1X2 snapshot with available_at <= cutoff, ordered by (available_at, collected_at, snapshot.id). Bookmaker identity is not a selection criterion; Pinnacle is not preferred.

odds.selection_policy: Last complete 1X2 snapshot with available_at <= cutoff, ordered by (available_at, collected_at, snapshot.id). Bookmaker identity is not a selection criterion; Pinnacle is not preferred.

freeze.note: The artefact is temporally frozen at calibration_select end_exclusive. Matches with event_at >= that instant are the only legitimate OOS sample for this frozen candidate, including its sigmoid calibrator.

training.latest_available_at_note: available_at is not a parquet column. Data-layer Elo updates use event_at + 3h; training labels satisfy event_at < train_end_exclusive.
